rows.basis: Fiscal 2024 AI revenue of $12.2 billion as stated in the Q4 FY2024 release; 12.2B ÷ total revenue 51,574M = 23.7%. It sits inside the Semiconductor solutions segment (30,096M), which also includes non-AI broadband, storage and wireless chips.
Full-year fiscal 2024 AI revenue guided at $12 billion in the Q3 FY2024 release, from Ethernet networking and custom accelerators. 12.0B ÷ 51,574M = 23.3%. The actual came in at $12.2 billion.

No full-year FY2025 AI revenue figure is in the pack. Releases state quarterly AI revenue: Q1 $4.1B, Q2 'over' $4.4B and Q3 $5.2B, which sum to $13.7B. Q4 is given only as +74% YoY, so the year cannot be summed. The call-coverage $20B figure is not a pack item. The Semiconductor solutions segment (36,858M) is not AI revenue.
